acceptance_criteria: Trait expanded. Destroy-all-children-in-set passes. cargo test exits 0.
close_reason: Removed would_create_cycle+node_has_children; added get_ancestors, get_descendant_ids, blob_exists, find_sibling_by_name; refactored destroy loop with all-covered check per RFC §3.2.3; updated MockBackend; 11 tests pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Bring backend.rs up to the planned interface. Remove would_create_cycle and node_has_children. Add 4 new methods. Update MockBackend. Rewrite handler logic that used the removed methods.

**Algorithm:**
1. In backend.rs remove would_create_cycle and node_has_children from FileNodeBackend.
2. Add:
   fn get_ancestors(&self, account_id: &Id, ids: &[Id]) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Vec<FileNode>, Self::Error>> + Send;
   fn get_descendant_ids(&self, account_id: &Id, id: &Id) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Vec<Id>, Self::Error>> + Send;
   fn blob_exists(&self, account_id: &Id, blob_id: &Id) -> impl Future<Output = bool> + Send;
   fn find_sibling_by_name(&self, account_id: &Id, parent_id: Option<&Id>, name: &str, case_insensitive: bool) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Option<Id>, Self::Error>> + Send;
3. Add use jmap_filenode_types::FileNode to backend.rs.
4. In lib.rs test_support MockBackend: remove set_has_children, set_cycle_pair, has_children, cycles fields. Add ancestors: HashMap<String, Vec<FileNode>>, descendants: HashMap<String, Vec<String>>, siblings: HashMap<(Option<String>, String), String>. Implement all 4 new methods.
5. In filenode.rs:
   - Replace would_create_cycle call: call get_descendant_ids, check if proposed new parent_id is in result set.
   - Replace node_has_children call: call get_descendant_ids, check result non-empty.
   - Add destroy-all-children-first check: before destroy loop, collect all destroy ids into a set. When onDestroyRemoveChildren=false: get_descendant_ids, if any descendant NOT in destroy_id_set → nodeHasChildren error. If all descendants are in destroy_id_set → allow (RFC §3.2.3 MUST NOT return error in this case).
6. Run cargo test --workspace.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- All existing handler tests pass.
- New test: destroy parent + all children in same request with onDestroyRemoveChildren=false → succeeds (MUST NOT return nodeHasChildren). Oracle: §3.2.3.
- Trait compiles with 4 new methods.
- MockBackend implements new trait.
- cargo test --workspace exits 0.
title: Expand FileNodeBackend trait: add get_ancestors, get_descendant_ids, blob_exists, find_sibling_by_name
